newsitem.title: THAILAND: New Thai banks plan provincial head offices.
newsitem.headline: New Thai banks plan provincial head offices.

text.p: Three newly licensed Thai banks said on Monday they would base their head offices in provincial commercial centres in compliance with a government policy to promote business development outside Bangkok.
Italian-Thai Development Plc said its consortium would launch a bank with a head office in northern Chiang Mai province.
General Finance and Securities Plc said its bank would be based in northeastern Khon Kaen province.
MBK Properties and Development Plc said it would open a bank based in northeastern Nakhon Ratchasima province.
The three companies each hold a five percent stake in their respective banks being launched with an initial capital of 7.5 billion baht ($300 million) each.

The domestic bank licences, the first granted by Thailand since 1966, had been approved by the previous government but charges of kickbacks during the selection process delayed their actual issue for more than six months.
